meta: Read your channel analytics with AI so your next video keeps viewers longer: high views don't always mean a good video.

muc.title: Views aren't enough
muc.text: High views don't always mean a good video; watch time shows how far the video keeps people.

muc.title: Numbers worth watching
muc.text: Mark học AI looks at three numbers: completion rate, the second viewers leave, and comments with questions.

muc.title: Keepers and droppers
muc.text: Paste a few videos' stats into a chatbot, an AI chat assistant, and ask it to compare the ones that held viewers with the ones scrolled past.

muc.title: Change just one thing
muc.text: Ask AI for one change for the next video, then measure again. Change several things at once and you won't know what worked.

muc.title: Your last five videos
muc.text: Paste the stats of your last five videos into a chatbot and ask which one kept viewers the longest.

thu: Paste the stats of your last 5 videos into a chatbot and ask which one kept viewers the longest.
